defects.title: role_handoff carries no information - 33/33 units are positionally derivable
defects.evidence: ch 3: H-D-C in all 12 units. ch 5: H-D-D-C in all 21. Every emitted role equals the positional default (first band = hook, last = consolidation, rest = development), zero deviations. The engine's uses are all ordinal too: CUT_COST makes unit boundaries free and post-opening cuts expensive; DEV_PACE_FLOOR protects middle bands; DEMOTE_BELOW demotes trailing ones.
defects.notes: Either the model shapes bands to the H..C arc (silent breach of Rule 15 prohibition 1) or the arc is universal (making the classification redundant) - both point the same way. PROPOSAL for the rollout: exception-only emission - the engine derives the positional default and Rule 15 asks for entries ONLY where a unit genuinely departs (all-development unit, two consolidations, mid-unit re-hook). Near-zero tokens, judgement still capturable, and a subject that never overrides tells us something. Decide before porting A3 to the other ten stages. | ARC STUDY 2026-07-30 (docs/testing_artefacts/arc_study_2026-07-30.md, 367 units, 5 subjects, no tokens): the corpus is unprimed - 40 of 43 backup plans predate role_handoff entirely. OPENING IS UNIVERSAL: hook markers at the first band in every subject at 1.7-2.4x its own middle rate (SS 89%, maths 82%, TWAU 75%, science 73%, english 55%). CLOSE IS NOT: consolidation markers at the last band are 47% science, 47% maths, 35% SS, 29% TWAU - and 16% in ENGLISH against 14%/14% at its own first and middle bands, i.e. completely flat. English units do not close, they stop. MIDDLE IS TIME: 10.4-13.8 min vs 5.3-9.1 at the edges, in every subject. Confound noted: maths shows 52% CONS at the FIRST band ('review the previous concept'), functionally a hook - the classifier reads language, not intent. CONCLUSION: the corpus supports 1.5 of the 3 roles, and position already carries what roles carry. Follow-up available if a constitutional change is to rest on this: LLM ground-truth classification of ~60 bands blind to position, approx Rs 3.

defects.title: Band granularity: count is invariant to period duration - measure, do not legislate yet
defects.evidence: 367 units across 45 plans: 3 bands=45, 4=228, 5=84, 6=10 (mean 4.16), essentially unchanged from 30-min to 60-min periods, so band LENGTH absorbs all duration variation. Largest band occupies 53-73% of a teacher's sitting at short durations. BUT ch 3 (3 bands, max 25 min) partitioned cleanly at 115/85/75/55% and at 30- and 35-min durations: correct regimes, coverage note fired, never a single-band sitting, minimum 2 bands per sitting. ch 5 (4 bands) behaves the same (67% vs 73%), so 3->4 buys ~6 points.
defects.notes: FOUNDER DECISION 2026-07-30: no minutes ceiling. A 25-30% cap would outlaw genuinely indivisible long activities (science practical, extended writing) and manufacture 'Part 1 / Part 2' splits; a 25% cap is also degenerate at 4 bands (forces all bands exactly equal). A 3-5 count guidance was considered and set aside as descriptive - it already covers 97.3% of observed units and does not bind distribution (3 bands can be 5/20/25). ACTION: measure instead - bands/unit and largest-band-share added to the provenance panel; C5/C7 across combos decide whether fat bands actually produce badly cut plans.
